risk_if_not_implemented: Without Bluetooth & Wireless Devices, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Bluetooth & Wireless Devices (CFG-04.9) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Functionality
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Functionality (CFG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Bluetooth & Wireless Devices (CFG-04.9) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
